instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Tell me whether my setup still has to be finished before anything else opens, and which one thing I must do now", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:see-what-holds-me and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads your setup steps (record:setup-steps rows, or the Get started answer you send as setup), your must-do list (record:waiting-on-you rows) and your hold setting, and answers cover { covered, key }: true while any required step is not done (the page draws only setup until then), null when nothing says, and key, the name your gate row gives the cover (required-setup when it gives none, so a missing key never leaves everything open).

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: setting (records:read); setting (records:read); setting (records:read); record:waiting-on-you (records:list); record:setup-steps (records:list).
